# Test fixtures

Everything here is generated by `generate.sh` from a **throwaway test PKI** — except the
`pades-*` files, which are the app's own PAdES output (see "PAdES golden"). No real (FNMT
or otherwise) key material is involved. Nothing in this directory is used at runtime — it
only feeds the verification tests.

## Contents

| Path | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `ca/test-root.crt` | self-signed root CA (`CA:TRUE`, `keyCertSign,cRLSign`) |
| `ca/test-intermediate.crt` | intermediate CA signed by the root (`pathlen:0`) |
| `ca/signer.crt` | end-entity signing certificate (`digitalSignature`, `emailProtection`), signed by the intermediate |
| `ca/chain.pem` | `signer.crt` **followed by** `test-intermediate.crt` (signer-first, what a verifier needs to build the chain) |
| `ca/*.key` | private keys — **gitignored**, regenerated on demand |
| `document.txt` | plain-ASCII invoice text (marker line + number/date/amount), CRLF line endings |
| `document-tampered.txt` | `document.txt` with exactly one digit changed, same byte length |
| `cades-valid.csig` | CMS `SignedData`, DER, **attached** content, signed attributes (contentType/messageDigest/signingTime) |
| `cades-tampered.csig` | `cades-valid.csig` with one embedded content byte patched in place (same length, DER intact) |
| `cades-detached.csig` | CMS `SignedData`, DER, **detached** content (verify against `document.txt`) |
| `xades-valid.xsig` | XAdES-EPES enveloped signature over an inline `<Factura>`; 2 references (document, `#SignedProperties`), RSA-SHA256 |
| `xades-tampered.xsig` | same file with one character changed inside the `<Importe>` text node (`SignatureValue` bytes untouched) |
| `pades-source.pdf` | 1-page PDF input for the PAdES signer; it is the byte-identical prefix of the golden |
| `pades-b-b-signed.pdf` | **golden** PAdES B-B signature over `pades-source.pdf`, produced by the app's own signer |
| `pades-signer.crt` / `pades-signer.key` | self-signed RSA signer that produced the golden; the key is a throwaway test key, tracked because the signer tests need it |
| `pades-signer-ec.crt` / `pades-signer-ec.key` | self-signed EC signer for the EC signing path (same throwaway-key rule) |
| `c14n/NN.xml` + `c14n/NN.c14n` | canonicalization oracle pairs: input, and the expected canonical output |

## PAdES golden

`pades-*` is **not** produced by `generate.sh`: it is the output of `signPdf` from
`src/lib/pades.ts`, pinned as the byte-level reference for the PAdES writer
(`src/lib/pades.test.ts`, `src/lib/verify.test.ts`) and re-verified independently by
`verify-fixtures.sh` (CMS `SignedData` over the PDF `/ByteRange`, detached, signer
`pades-signer.crt`). It is tracked on purpose so a regression shows up as a diff, not as
silently different output. To refresh it, re-sign `pades-source.pdf` with the app's signer
and keep the same signer key, or the golden and `pades-signer.crt` stop matching.

## Regenerate

```bash
bash test/fixtures/generate.sh
```

Idempotent, no network, `openssl` + `python3` (stdlib) only. Requires **OpenSSL ≥ 3.4** for the
pinned `-not_before`/`-not_after` window; the script refuses older builds before touching the
corpus (CI uses Debian trixie / OpenSSL 3.5). It wipes `ca/`,
`scratch/` and `c14n/` first, then rewrites the files listed above (never `pades-*`) and
self-checks (the XAdES digests are recomputed from the finished file and the
`SignatureValue` is verified against `ca/signer.crt`).

## Cross-check

```bash
bash test/fixtures/verify-fixtures.sh
```

Prints one `ok ...` line per check, exits 1 on the first mismatch. Positive *and*
negative checks: tampered inputs must be rejected, valid ones accepted. The `pades-*` golden
is checked here too: its `/ByteRange` must cover everything but `/Contents`, and the embedded
CMS `SignedData` must verify over those bytes with `pades-signer.crt` (and fail after a patch).

## Notes for the verifier implementation

* **Throwaway PKI.** The certificates are regenerated locally; `*.key` never
  leaves the working copy and is gitignored. Chains are tested with
  `-CAfile ca/test-root.crt` (never the system store). Certificate validity is
  pinned to `2023-01-01 .. 2033-01-01` (a 10-year window, as with `-days 3650`)
  instead of "notBefore = now", so the fixed XAdES `SigningTime`
  (`2026-01-15T10:30:00Z`) always falls inside the validity of the signer.
* **`document.txt` uses CRLF** on purpose: `cms -sign` writes it with `-binary`
  (raw bytes) while `cms -verify -content` applies S/MIME text canonicalization
  (CRLF), so only CRLF keeps both paths byte-identical.
* **Canonicalization.** Every digest and `SignatureValue` here was produced with
  `python3 -c` `xml.etree.ElementTree.canonicalize(..., strip_text=False,
  with_comments=False)`. The `c14n/*.c14n` oracles pin its exact behaviour, in
  particular: a namespace declaration is emitted on the element where its prefix
  is first *used* (not necessarily where it was declared) and declarations that
  are never used are dropped, whitespace text nodes are kept, `<`/`>`/`&` and CR
  are escaped, and empty elements are expanded. An XAdES verifier that emits
  inherited-but-unused namespace declarations (e.g. `xmlns:ds` on
  `SignedProperties`) will not reproduce Reference 2 — see `c14n/02`.
* **XAdES layout** is single-line, with no comments and no processing
  instructions, so that removing the `ds:Signature` element for Reference 1 is
  unambiguous regardless of how the verifier handles whitespace.
